name: Canvas Page Metatag
description: Re-exposes the full set of Metatag SEO tag groups (Basic, Advanced, Open Graph, Facebook, Twitter Cards) on Drupal Canvas (Experience Builder) page edit forms.
project_description: Canvas Page Metatag gives Drupal Canvas pages (canvas_page entities) the same full Metatag editing experience that ordinary fieldable entities already have. By default Canvas's own page edit form hides almost every Metatag field down to a single SEO title; this module re-exposes the Basic (description, abstract, keywords), Advanced (robots, referrer, etc.), Open Graph, Facebook, and Twitter Cards groups, each independently toggleable from a settings page. It works purely through Form API: hook_form_canvas_page_form_alter() restores #access on the elements Canvas hides. It also fixes a genuine compatibility bug where Canvas's React builder UI submits Metatag's Robots checkboxes as the generic boolean 1 instead of the option key, by repairing the value in a targeted #after_build callback. No custom rendering is added — Metatag's own page-attachment mechanisms emit the configured tags into the page <head> once the required submodules are installed.
